notes.title: Holy Potatoes! The First Update?!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/23f32a6b3bdceea5e8e07e1a5ba6c10ca3403835.png[/img]

Hey Spudlings,

So it has been more than a day since the launch of Holy Potatoes! A Spy Story?!. 
We would like to thank you for your unwavering support for the game. Not only did you purchase the game and enjoy it, but you also provided us with constructive feedback and suggestions to make the game better.
We listened to your feedback, and here we are, with the first update for the game, to improve the gameplay experience further:

- Minor Bug Fix. Previously, mission expiry tutorial will not show if you have seen the tutorial in an earlier gameplay. 
- Minor Bug Fix. Previously, multiple skills might be activated in the same turn in special missions.
- Slight nerf to obstacles’ stats! Spies will now have an easier time to clear missions. 
- Slight increase in mission expiry time. Now you can be a couch potato [spoiler](not really)[/spoiler] and take your time.

Have fun playing!
[b]Daylight Studios[/b]

Heya Spudlings,

It has been more than a week since the end of our beta for Holy Potatoes! A Spy Story?! (HPSPY), and we would like to [b]thank you all for participating in the closed beta[/b]. We were overwhelmed by the positive responses from you, the players, as well as your support for the game. Our team is currently working hard to evaluate your feedback and implement changes based on your suggestions.

But that is not the purpose of you being here right? So scroll down for our dev updates, fresh from the Daylight’s oven.



Beside the common bugs reported, one of the most requested features is the difficulty settings, because we all [strike]suck[/strike] are not very good with time and [strike]money[/strike] Starch management, aren’t we?                     
        ヾ(´囗｀｡)ﾉ. We listen to your suggestion, and here we go, the difficulty settings at the start of the game, so you have a choice to be a casual or an ultimate hardcore spud.

notes.title: Egging On!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/b2d34281188e59eee13ec6f67ad131560527a740.gif[/img]

Hey Spudlings! 

Welcome back to a Thursday Update :D We’ve been working on polishing and refining A Spy Story?! now, and here are a few new features! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/9c678b1e1f78ccfbb30e6aa5ad1266b7d8e12d2c.gif[/img]

You can now choose to accept side missions at your own pace! There’s no expiration for these side missions until you accept them. Each case will contain a different number of missions, and you’ll only be able to collect the reward when all related missions to the case are completed. 

However, missions that are central to the plot will still be popping up on the mission list, so you’ll have to finish them in time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/561174b4f42dd2f3d8ba84da49110228e9e92f1a.gif[/img]

And here’s the reward for completing the mission :D  As missions increase in difficulty level, you’ll wind up with different kinds of rewards. Some of them can be central to completing main missions, so don’t forget about them! 

As always, thank you for reading, and ghhs iulhg ryhu erlohg~ 

Cheers, 
The Spud from U.N.C.L.E.

notes.title: Last Sited
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/8aa1e5a42a6bf929a6182f0eec4903935327f938.gif[/img]

Hey Spudlings!

As you can see, we’ve spiced up the animations for the mission control. Here are other animations for different actions! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/8217c1390ea06ff13e3ba5a921acef1b45a880d8.gif[/img]

Other than switching up the animation, we’ve also uploaded more expressions so you’ll be able to keep track of your spies’ progress in missions or in training centres. It’s pretty cute, if I do say so myself - though Spyderman’s eyes shouldn’t be able to narrow like that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/5d354fbedb9c068725e44f9b7f310ea095b65a37.gif[/img]

Though the game’s really coming together, we’ve also been discussing how to keep things hyped up for players - A Spy Story?! is more strategic in nature, and has a unique Holy Potatoes! take on the spy genre. Hence, the first few minutes of gameplay may be quite contrary to expectations of the genre. 

One way we’ve tried is to introduce an interesting cast (as you’ve seen, Souper Maria and Spyderman) instead of regular randomnised spies. Another would be the ability to plan and shape your own spy agency. 

We’ve still got a month or so, so let’s try our best! 

-- .- -.- . / - .... . / .-.. .. -. -.- / --.- .- -.-- ....- ----- .-.. -...

On a separate note, we’re finally able to announce that HPAWS will be officially released on PS4 and Nintendo Switch on 10 and 12 July respectively! Just in case you missed the announcement ;)

notes.title: Meeting Ad-June-d!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/a2e66d74f4929197489c310ee8f9ba23b4a517c2.gif[/img]

[i]...Stealth or just a bug in Unity? Either way, time is of the essence! [/i]

Hello Spudlings!

It’s been a pretty productive week; as we draw closer to the end of June, we’re glad to say that things are going to get even busier! 

On the art side, as you can see, most of the decorations and training stations are complete. We’ll have to polish and resize some of it - though, really, who wouldn’t want a giant Mochi shrine? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/03244880f05f5a542b70f6840997d3394f172919.png[/img]

.. / .... --- .--. . / -.-- --- ..- / .-. . -- . -- -... . .-. / - .... . / -.- . -.-- / -..- .....

We’re also working on setting changes such as save/load game features and volume controls. Here’s a mock-up of the save game panel! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/20cdbd9064c31c511180f2b6d8b8b38c7d794aff.jpg[/img]

The tutorial, too, is complete! You may have noticed the changes in colour scheme - they were made to better centre our players' attention on the content.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/55a6ff8ec5e5bd27fc11de7c9f1c85f0bcff366f.png[/img]

We’re also working with Jeffrey Brice for this game - you can check his [url=https://twitter.com/jeffbrice]twitter[/url] out here, and his [url=https://www.jeffbricemusic.com/]website[/url] here. It’s been a pleasure working with his compositions for the past few games, and we’re looking forward to some more snazzy tunes for this coming Spy Story?! 

- .... .. ... / -. . -..- - / .-. .. -.. -.. .-.. . / .. ... / .- / --- -. . / - .. -- . / - .... .. -. --.

In the meantime, HPAWS will be available on both Nintendo Switch and PS4 [i]real soon[/i], so keep an eye out for that! We’re also starting work on HPWIS, but that will likely take a while longer.

notes.title: Our First Update: Your Eyes Only
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/eae117c51c62c86315f53888e6b55841aa6a3e71.gif[/img]

THIS SUMMER - From the producers that brought you potato arms dealers (HPAWS), space colonisation (HPWIS), and cannibalism (HPWTH), comes a thrilling sequel of espionage: [b]Holy Potatoes! A Spy Story?![/b]  


Meet twins Ren and Rexa in their headquarters, and follow as they untangle the mysteries of an evil spy corporation.


.- .-. . / -.-- --- ..- / .- -.-. - ..- .- .-.. .-.. -.-- / -.. . -.-. --- -.. .. -. --. / - .... . ... .


Hey Spudlings!


We hope you’ve enjoyed this snippet we created to introduce A Spy Story?! If you’d like to see more, you can head over to our [url=holypotatoesgame.com]website[/url] for a longer interactive cut. As a heads’ up, we’ll be going into greater detail into the characters and their origin stories for our next post!



We’re sorry for the long wait - besides working on this latest game, we’ve also been swamped with other projects; publishing previous titles to PS4 and Switch, getting HPWIS on mobile, localising different languages and so on! Keep your eyes peeled for them, oh, and -


In the meantime, why not join our Discord at https://discord.me/holypotatoes for future giveaways, contests and bragging rights ;)



Plugging aside, we’ll be back with updates every week or so. So here’s a quick rundown of what we’ve been up to in the past week!



.--. .-.. . .- ... . / .--- --- .. -. / --- ..- .-. / -.. .. ... -.-. --- .-. -..



[b]Bear with Me[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/b4c3670925839509e4ec6314be23fda18f3356ff.jpg[/img]


Our artists have been hard at work, making our assets sharper! Can you tell the difference between the two buildings? We’ve also undergone a resizing - scaling every potato-spy, building and tree to proportion. The downsizing also makes it easier to click on different buildings now!



-.-- --- ..- .----. .-. . / ... - .. .-.. .-.. / .- - / .. - ..--.. / .-- .... .- - / .- / -. . .-. -..


[b]I Spy with My Little Eye…[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/5715e3b472ae82b8a32e97f1076b00653935705c.jpg[/img]


Something beginning with K. Hint: it’s hovering somewhere above the recruitment centre.



..-. ..- -. / ..-. .- -.-. - / -.- ..- -- --- / .-.. --- ...- . ... / .--. --- - .- - --- / ... .... .- .--. . -.. / -.-. .- .-. .-. --- - ...



[b]Sounding Things Out[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/67b9271070ba297717e5b26c36562436a7d06a99.gif[/img]


Concerns regarding the potato sprites’ outlines were raised too: due to the use of 3D sprites previously, constant rendering in the game produced image noise. As such, we’re running with 2D sprites instead! Let’s hope they don’t go off the grid! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32565025/faa6ddbc3efb33f7411447d7a0abf29e9b53482d.jpg[/img]
